title: ATL-42 - API rate limits block launch sync
content: The Atlas launch sync is blocked by API rate limits from the partner service. The retry/backoff patch is in progress and must be deployed before end-to-end validation can start.
author: Maya Chen

title: ATL-51 - production observability review
content: Observability dashboards and alert thresholds are ready for review. The ticket is in review and Jordan Lee is waiting for approval before the launch checklist can be closed.
author: Jordan Lee
